beats.trigger: first meaningful scroll or direct interaction
beats.purpose: deliver the single memorable interaction tied to the subject

rules: Prefer transform, opacity, filter and clip-path; do not animate layout properties in hot paths.
Use one coordinated entrance and one signature interaction instead of continuous motion everywhere.
Scroll animation must preserve native input, focus navigation and content access.
Pause offscreen work and avoid unbounded decorative frame loops.
Never gate content, navigation or conversion behind animation completion.

reduced_motion.behavior: Honor prefers-reduced-motion. Replace translation, scale, parallax and smooth scrolling with immediate state changes or short opacity transitions.
reduced_motion.verification: Test the actual OS/browser reduced-motion mode in Playwright or a real browser, not only a code branch.
